task: Bound large standalone CUDA SDPA scratch without lowering intermediate precision
outcome: Applied Q blocking/liveness reuse, strict per-operation cuBLAS math mode and F16 F32-math fallback. No throughput claim.

baseline.provider: Fresh retained pre-change HEAD source; not the stale b-cuda-d5 provider DLL.
baseline.native_for_final_comparison: Both baseline and candidate prepend the same new host dispatch object with current MMF guards and scoped cuBLAS DEFAULT_MATH.
baseline.f16_limit: Old baseline still uses Half PV flash accumulation, candidate uses F32 math. F16 is not a same-precision throughput comparison.

implementation.trigger: Single-node ScaledDotProductAttention recipe, Q>1, conservative four-score estimate above 8 MiB.
implementation.block: At most 128 query rows, reduced using a conservative 64 MiB score budget; at least one row.
implementation.semantics: Full KV per block; bottom-right n_past=KV-Q_total+q_begin; scale before masking; original output strides and copy terminals.
implementation.lifetime: One native graph in existing root-stream order; ggml gallocr reuses intermediates. Cold reserve precedes real port binding; first submit initializes graph allocation only after valid addresses exist. Subsequent submits refresh views. Invocation drains before freeing scratch.
implementation.precision: QK/probability/PV remain F32 in ggml math; only final output casts to F16/BF16. Explicit F32-source cuBLAS calls temporarily use DEFAULT_MATH and restore private handle mode, including unwind.
implementation.complexity: Arithmetic remains O(Q*KV*D). Score scratch is O(B*H*KV*block_rows), with additional linear K/V casts/transposition and block metadata/launches.
implementation.budget_limit: 64 MiB is a row-selection target, not total private/VRAM bound. A minimum one-row allocation may itself exceed it; ports, native pools, cuBLAS and driver are separate.

validation.budgets: Existing F16 absolute .002 and BF16 .01 unchanged. New F32 short/prefix tests use .00001. Separate long space-probe budget failures remain failures.
validation.cases: Nonzero QK/FP64 oracle, GQA, decode, non-square bottom-right, zero/negative scale, noncausal Q>KV, block/tail/batch strides, two invocations/Queues, rebind, BF16 exponent range, F16 weak probability times large V, MLA cold admission.
validation.closure: Current provider TU and fresh dense-rank4 F32/F16/BF16 constructor helper. Other tensor lowering explicitly declines. Reused same foundation cache/native kernel archive with fresh strict host overlay.
validation.compile: MSVC14.50 /W4 /WX current provider and test TU; only one native dispatch TU rebuilt with NVCC, no all-kernel rebuild.
validation.not_run: Full current IQ1 backend, ordinary default provider roster, generic Graph GPU tests, allocation-fault matrix and Linux CUDA.
validation.dependency_integrity: cmake -P check-patch-lock.cmake passed for ggml_cuda_runtime_patches, including updated NOTICE/tree/version.
validation.discovery_limits: Early cached-provider and pre-overlay numerical failures are forensic records, not current same-precision baselines. Exact final commands/source are retained; early mutable test helper versions were not all frozen.

space_method.consumer: Actual Hyle Direct, CUDA device resource, SharedQueue and owning Completion wait. Fresh process per shape.
space_method.input: B1 Hq8 Hkv2 D256 Q=KV, Q/K zero, V=1.25, full output observed.
space_method.explicit_counter: Cold sum of owned ggml scratch buffer sizes and ggml_gallocr_get_buffer_size. Separate probe-only snapshots append one stderr counter; normal test DLL unchanged.
space_method.excluded: External ports, native allocator pools, cuBLAS workspace, runtime/driver, total device peak.
space_method.cuda_mem_info: Synchronized per-phase used-memory snapshots, including other clients; not peak counters or same as explicit private allocation.
space_method.initial_probe_source: numerics/space.initial.cc; original first-ten source SHA verified against run identity.
space_method.hash_probe_source: numerics/space.cc; output SHA256 added for the four followups; same values and unchanged budget.

numeric_limits.f32_large_space_probe: Both 2K and 8K baseline/candidate fail the self-selected absolute 1e-5 budget, max 3.43323e-5 and .00014174. Full output SHA256 matches respectively. No tolerance change and no numeric pass claimed for those points; allocation counts remain factual.
numeric_limits.f16_8k: Old flash constant output max error .149414; new F32 math zero. This diagnoses a precision gap and is not a fair old/new throughput ranking.
numeric_limits.torch_f16: Native Half efficient weak-probability case fails .002 with max .027413951. Half->Float efficient(TF32x3)->Half passes only this case but remains a different intermediate domain; neither extension/default route was enabled.
numeric_limits.torch_f16_space_limit: Its recorded peak starts after promotions and excludes the three Float input casts; no full Hyle-route space or speed measurement.

archives.provider-source.zip: Current/baseline/provider-helper/native-overlay/diagnostic sources, exact build commands, source hashes, F16 source-level review and pure cuBLAS causal probe. Original provider metadata reports the earlier nine-test checkpoint; final ten-test record is above.
archives.raw-results.zip: All local numeric/space logs and identities, both space consumers, final regression/reference snapshots, runners and rejected F16 native experiment archive.
